status.description: 'going' = intends to attend (counts toward the cap). 'interested' = soft interest, does not count toward the cap.

subject.description: Strong-ref to the app.zeens.event being responded to.

main.description: An RSVP to an app.zeens.event, written to the responder's own PDS. This record is the responder's declaration of intent only. The organiser's decision on a gated event (approve / decline / waitlist) is NOT stored here (the organiser cannot mutate another user's repo); it lives off-protocol in PocketBase. Email-only RSVPs from people without a PDS are tracked entirely off-protocol. Carries the app.zeens.v marker.
